en: Draft animals: working animals that pull carts and farm implements. On the kolkhoz, horses do this work.
Household plot: a family's own garden and animals. Its produce belongs to the family, not the kolkhoz.
Own draft power: the share of all work in the last completed year done with kolkhoz horses. Manual work and the district's visiting machinery crew do not increase this share.
Party cell: a local group of party members on the kolkhoz. They meet to discuss shared affairs. A local party organizer arranges the group's work.
District land office: the department that sends the kolkhoz its produce delivery plan.
Satisfaction: how well a family lives on the kolkhoz. It depends on food, housing, rest and other living conditions, and affects family members' work. Mood is an individual resident's personal state.
Komsomol placement: the youth league refers a young specialist to work on a kolkhoz. The chairman requests the required profession from the district.
Livestock boarding: temporarily keeping kolkhoz animals in household yards while collective livestock sheds lack space.
